summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine PDMR transaction under UK/EU market-abuse disclosure rules, the non-US equivalent of a US Form 4 insider report. Maya Martinez-Davis, President, US, acquired 9.414 notional American Depositary Shares at $50.7200 within her GSK Executive Supplemental Savings Plan account on 2026-09-22 via the New York Stock Exchange. The notional acquisition reflects plan-directed deferred compensation rather than an open-market purchase. No board recommendation, advisor, stake change, premium or structural terms are involved. No special-situation event; no risk-arb angle, only routine insider-holding disclosure.
